title: OBSERVATORIO 07 · La última constelación
briefLiteral: Quiero una habitación jugable 3D con un puzle de varios pasos: pistas, objetos manipulables, mecanismo de salida, estados coherentes y reinicio, con interacción móvil.

tech.assets: Original geometry, CanvasTexture drawn in browser; no third-party image/model assets
tech.artLicense: Original project-specific authored material; Three.js MIT

preproduction.strategyA: Import CC0/downloaded antique interiors as glTF: visually rich but inconsistent scale, licensing verification and larger mobile bytes.
preproduction.strategyB: Custom authored parametric observatory: structural meshes, decorative metalwork, authored star chart, moveable mirrors and crystal, no external art assets.
preproduction.reason: Playable object interactions and state coherence take precedence; original built-in assets ensure known origin and editable mechanics. Environment fully constructed rather than a generic blockout.
riskMitigation: Independent logical state for dials, crystal, mirrors, exit
Preserve source branch and public path isolation

loop: take crystal from unlocked desk drawer
rotate reflector I to 3 and II to 2
gameplay.camera: drag orbit, pinch or wheel zoom
